stickyNotes.text: Clicking "Open in Workbench" passes the exact clicked ticket row via navigate("page_ticket_workbench", "row") so Master-Detail focuses that work order without popups.
Popup-free Master-Detail: autoSelectFirst selects the first ticket on load, and Card(activeTable="t_srv_tickets") isolates detail forms and child tables from cross-table source rows.
Cross-field Poka-Yoke: visit_end_date enforces minField="visit_start_date" while contact_phone validates phone format and sla_hours enforces [0.5, 72] before writing.

Foreign-key closure: tickets with unreturned srv_part_usages rows are blocked by ON DELETE RESTRICT (try WO-202611-01); tickets with 0 parts archive cleanly with ON DELETE CASCADE on srv_ticket_logs and a 5s Undo toast (try WO-202611-03).
High-risk confirmation guard: requires typing the exact current {{row.ticket_no}} before transitioning status to Closed.
Anti-overclaim & deduplication: apply_qty enforces maxField="stock_available" and table srv_part_usages enforces composite unique uq_srv_ticket_part(ticket_id, part_code).
Disambiguated status ENUM lanes: automatically binds srv_tickets.status (ignoring priority ENUM) and syncs lane moves live with the monthly/weekly Calendar below.
Cross-platform shared ER dataset: status updates or van spare-part claims on iPhone update desktop KPIs, Kanban lanes, and Master-Detail child tables immediately.

notes.title: SLA State Machine, Foreign-Key Guards & Undo Recovery Spec
notes.html:
1. Service Ticket Lifecycle (srv_tickets.status)

  • Pending Dispatch → On-Site → Pending Sign-Off → Closed.
  • Force-closing from non-terminal states requires typing the exact ticket_no in the confirmation modal.

2. Relational Foreign-Key & Poka-Yoke Invariants

  1. Spare Parts Guard (RESTRICT): srv_part_usages.ticket_id uses ON DELETE RESTRICT and composite unique uq_srv_ticket_part(ticket_id, part_code), with apply_qty <= stock_available.
  2. Diagnostic Logs (CASCADE + 5s Undo): srv_ticket_logs.ticket_id uses ON DELETE CASCADE; archiving a part-free ticket offers a 5-second atomic Undo that re-validates unique constraints before restoring parent + child rows.
  3. UI Stack 5-State Matrix: Switch Ideal / Empty / Loading / Edge / Error in the top bar; Edge stress-test strings never leak back into stored project rows.
